 SPCX +0.08%

 Learn more Tesla (NasdaqGS:TSLA) and SpaceX have each formed special committees to evaluate a potential all-stock merger, according to a new report. 
 The review coincides with Tesla's next-generation Roadster unveiling, which has fueled fresh questions about SpaceX technology being incorporated into the vehicle. 
 Industry analysts are split, with some highlighting possible shareholder dilution and others focusing on potential cross-company use of rocket, chip, and communication tech. 
 The possible Tesla SpaceX all-stock merger and Roadster reveal matter, but investors should weigh Tesla on more than this headline. We have also flagged 1 other big win for Tesla. 
 Consider widening your watchlist to other companies tied to similar long-term technology themes through 53 AI infrastructure stocks . 
 NasdaqGS:TSLA Earnings & Revenue Growth as at Nov 2026 Tesla designs and sells electric vehicles plus energy generation and storage systems across the US, China, and other global markets. Any closer tie to SpaceX brings its auto and battery operations into the same conversation as advanced rocket and communication technology. 
 We've flagged 3 risks for Tesla. See which could impact your investment. 
 How could a Tesla SpaceX all stock merger change the business mix? 
 A combined group would bring rockets, satellite connectivity and AI heavy chip work directly alongside Tesla's vehicles, storage and software. That would place more emphasis on services and infrastructure that sit on top of physical products rather than relying only on selling cars and batteries. 
 Does this change the Tesla Narrative around autonomy and heavy spending? 
 The existing Narrative already focuses on large outlays for robotaxis, Optimus, AI chips and energy infrastructure that are intended to become scaled, profitable platforms after a period of thin margins and negative free cash flow. A merger review adds SpaceX optionality on AI, chips and connectivity on top of that same high capex, high execution risk path rather than replacing it. 
 See how these catalysts shape Tesla's path to a $408 fair value . 
 What is the clearest early signal to watch next? 
 The first key proof point sits with the special committees and board decisions. A jointly announced deal framework that includes valuation terms, an exchange ratio and separate votes for Tesla outside shareholders would indicate that this has moved from discussion into a defined transaction that can then be weighed against dilution and integration risk.
